Japan-Only 2027 MINI Countryman Nightfall Edition Goes Live, 200 Units Available
6 photos
Photo: MINI / edited
The BMW-controlled MINI brand has unleashed yet another special edition of the Countryman. Exclusive to Japan, the Nightfall Edition is a diesel-powered crossover with dark exterior detailing, a brown-and-black interior, and plenty of standard kit. Merely 200 units are in the offing, with prices kicking off at 6,000,000 yen (approximately 37,500 dollars at current exchange rates).
As with many so-called special editions from the British manufacturer, there is nothing particularly special under the skin, where you will find the Countryman D's powertrain completely unchanged. A dedicated launch event for the Nightfall Edition is due on November 14 and 15, and yes, all 200 units come in RHD.
Nightfall implies the transition from dusk into darkness, and the Slate Blue paintwork definitely evokes the deepening blue of the evening sky. A black roof and black-painted mirror caps add to the visual theme, and then there's Piano Black for the exterior trim pieces that remove most of the otherwise bright trim. 19-inch John Cooper Works Runway Spoke black wheels are on the menu as well.
Not exactly look-at-me special, but I and many other enthusiasts certainly dig the restrained approach. Truth be told, MINI doesn't need another collection of decorative stripes and oversized graphics to help the Countryman stand out in the crowd. It's already a looker, and the combination of dark blue and black perfectly suits it without turning the Nightfall Edition into a rolling accessories catalog.
The cabin receives pretty restrained updates as well, with MINI combining a predominantly black interior with Vescin Vintage Brown upholstery to create a bi-tone environment. Vescin is the MINI way of saying 100 percent vegan synthetic leather. Moving on, the Favoured trim adds John Cooper Works body-hugging seats and a sporty steering wheel to this Japanese market-only model.
Photo: MINI Electric adjustments for the front seats are standard as well, along with an active driver's seat, driver's seat memory, and rear privacy glass. The list continues with a Harman Kardon audio system, an interior camera, adaptive cruise control with stop & go, lane-departure warning, hands-off driving assistance on highways, lane-change warning, and collision-avoidance braking with steering assist.
Another piece of the active safety package includes cross-traffic warning. Parking Assistant Plus, meanwhile, handles low-speed maneuvering. PAP includes protection against unintended acceleration caused by incorrect pedal operation, 360-degree cameras, and automatic parallel plus perpendicular parking assist. According to MINI Japan, the four-pot diesel underhood is good for 150 ps at 4,000 rpm and no more than 360 Nm between 1,500 and 2,500 rpm.
Only available with two pedals, the 148-horsepower turbo diesel offers the kind of low-down torque that should make the Nightfall Edition perfect for most everyday driving scenarios. In the combined test cycle, said BMW-sourced engine tops 17.4 kilometers per liter of dinosaur juice, a figure that can be read as 5.7 liters per 100 kilometers in Europe or 40.9 miles per gallon in the US.
The Countryman is MINI 's best-selling model worldwide, and its popularity is extremely obvious in the SUV-driven market. In the first nine months of 2026, it moved 8,670 units compared to 4,021 for the Cooper Hardtop 2 Door, 3,669 for the five-door hatchback, and 3,887 for the convertible version of the Cooper.
